title: SG-5.2 · Scene object entity with hover, label, click, actions and keyboard access
summary: SceneObject gains bounds, hover highlight, name label, click event, contextual actions, visibility and keyboard focus/activation through a shared interaction helper
description: Context: game/src/entities/SceneObject.ts only creates a sprite (key, position, scale, depth) and toggles visibility from visibleWhen. No interaction helper exists in game/src/systems yet. Desired behavior: every authored ObjectSpec becomes an interactive entity. Expected result: hover highlights the object and shows its name, a click or keyboard activation emits an event carrying the object id and its currently available actions. Why: interactive bedroom objects must be data-driven and keyboard accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pointer position inside an object's interactionBounds, When hit-tested, Then the helper reports a hit and a position outside reports a miss
Given an object with actions guarded by conditions, When the state changes, Then only actions whose conditions pass are listed
Given a pointer over the object, When hover starts and ends, Then highlight and name label toggle on and off
Given a click or Enter/Space on a focused visible object, When activated, Then an interact event with the object id and available actions is emitted

in_scope: SceneObject hover, label, click, focus and activation
buildScene focus cycling and interact callback
preserve: Existing SceneObject sprite creation arguments and visibility sync

technical_constraints: Engine code stays free of Phaser imports; rendering goes through RenderContext
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units
Unit tests green with fake render context
